reviews.title: Perfect for Zoom and desk videos!
reviews.comment: I do a lot of Zoom meetings for work and plan on doing podcast style Zoom meetings with clients so this is the best setup. It’s very sturdy and holds my Shure MV7+ well and it’s compatible with other Shure mics as well. It’s very well designed and can move around pretty well. It comes with an adapter so most mics should be able to fit. The price point was amazing as well since other similar quality arms would cost a lot more. This is very high quality.
reviews.author: Weekend Shopper

reviews.title: The most important tool on my desk!!
reviews.comment: This Low Profile Boom Arm is exactly what I needed for my setup! It’s built solidly and feels extremely sturdy, easily handling my heavy Shure SM7B without any sagging. The gear lock structure really makes a difference—once you set it in place, it stays locked and stable, even after hours of use. The low-profile design is perfect for keeping my desk area clean and uncluttered while giving me full range of motion to position the mic exactly where I want it. Installation was simple, and the desk mount is strong and secure without wobbling. It works beautifully not just with the SM7B, but also with my Yeti and Rode PodMic, so it’s versatile too. Overall, this is a professional-quality boom arm that looks sleek, feels premium, and performs flawlessly. Highly recommend for streamers, podcasters, or anyone using a heavier microphone!
reviews.author: MB

reviews.title: Affordable Mic Arm Stand
reviews.comment: The Quality is quite impressive, definitely would say great for the price. Cable management system is simple to use and setup, would definitely say the durability of the nobs it being plastic would have ben great to be metallic, for the size/fit of the location it will definitely would have be within your preference and set up. But really great fit. The appearance is minimalistic and very sleek. Finally the overall durability of the item is well made and has a great feel and extremely easy installation. The Mic im currently using is the Shure MV7+
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Clean look, Easy to Put Together, Reliable Build. 4.5/5
reviews.comment: I love it. It easy to use once you mess with it for about 5 minutes, it works very well in my studio by looking nice as well as noting being in the way. The Joints feel tough due to its twist lock feature (Its good that it stays where you put it, but i have a minor nitpick about it having specific heights that it locks in at, but that's just the trade off for the quality i feel). I do wish that the clamp was larger in surface area to prevent slight bounciness of the boom arm (Genuinely isn't a big deal, just finding something to nitpick at this point.). They also have several thread adapters inside the box so it is VERY versatile. Clean Look, Easy to use/Put Together, Reliable build. Almost a 5 star, but doesn't feel like it should be 5 stars, id say more 4.5 tbh. I'd highly recommend this boom arm.
reviews.author: Austin

reviews.title: This is a great mic stand.
reviews.comment: This is a very well made product.  Good materials, and an excellent fit and finish, and was very simple to assemble.  The clamp is solid, and the stand is extremely stable.  The integrated cable channel keeps the cable out of sight.  The "sound quality" will depend entirely on the quality of your mic, shock mount, filters, etc. - but the mic stand itself certainly isn't going to get in your way.  It's rock solid. If this product is indicative, I wouldn't hesitate to give the brand's other products a chance if they adressed my needs.
reviews.author: Alan Robertson
